### 1. Scene
A meal of two small pizza pieces, a leafy mixed salad, and roasted potato and eggplant pieces.

### 2. Vessel
A large, rounded-square dinner plate, approximately 27 cm across. Using an equivalent circular diameter of **28 cm** gives an estimated usable area of:
**3.14 × 14² = 615 cm².**

### 3. Items
Visible foods are tomato-and-cheese pizza, leafy greens, salad toppings (beans, corn, carrot and tomato), roasted potatoes and eggplant, and a light oily salad dressing.

### 4–7. Area, volume, weight and energy
Areas are allocated without double-counting overlapping salad ingredients. Dressing coats the salad rather than occupying additional plate area.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Tomato-and-cheese pizza | 22% | 135 × 1.3 = 176 ml | 0.90 | 158 g | 260 | 411 kcal |
| Leafy greens | 26% | 160 × 2.7 = 432 ml | 0.15 | 65 g | 25 | 16 kcal |
| Beans, corn, carrot and tomato | 10% | 62 × 0.9 = 56 ml | 0.65 | 36 g | 90 | 32 kcal |
| Roasted potatoes and eggplant | 23% | 141 × 2.0 = 282 ml | 0.65 | 184 g | 110 | 202 kcal |
| Oily salad dressing | Coating | Approximately 4 ml | 1.00 | 4 g | 880 | 35 kcal |

Food covers approximately **81%** of the plate. The roasted-vegetable energy estimate includes cooking oil; the separate dressing estimate applies only to the salad.

### 8. Sanity check
Approximately **447 g and 696 kcal** is plausible for the visible quantities. The pizza and oil contribute most of the energy, while the bulky greens contribute relatively little weight. A reasonable uncertainty range is roughly **380–520 g and 560–840 kcal**.
